campaigns.name: Irish Corporate Year-End & Statutory Compliance Briefing
campaigns.template_body:
Dear {CONTACT_NAME},

As Irish corporate year-end statutory deadlines approach, many mid-market leaders at companies like {BUSINESS_NAME} are reviewing their statutory audit exemption thresholds, CRO Form B1 compliance, and cross-border VAT structures.

SENVO provides end-to-end statutory accounting, Revenue compliance, and company secretarial advisory tailored to Irish trading entities.

Would you be open to a brief 10-minute introductory call next Tuesday or Wednesday to discuss your current compliance schedule?

Would you be open to exchanging notes on how our advisory practice supports Irish tech entities?

company_knowledge.title: Accounting, Bookkeeping & Payroll Management
company_knowledge.content: Comprehensive statutory accounts preparation, monthly management accounts, and Revenue-compliant Irish payroll processing (including PAYE Modernisation, benefit-in-kind, and BrightPay integration).

company_knowledge.title: Audit, CRO & Statutory Compliance
company_knowledge.content: Independent statutory audits, audit exemption assessments under the Companies Act 2014, and complete Companies Registration Office (CRO) compliance including Form B1 annual return filings.

company_knowledge.title: Irish Corporation Tax, VAT & Cross-Border Advisory
company_knowledge.content: Corporation tax computations (Form CT1), bi-monthly VAT3 filing via ROS, Reverse Charge mechanism, EU cross-border trading VAT compliance, and Revenue Ireland audit defense support.

company_knowledge.title: Company Secretarial & Corporate Governance
company_knowledge.content: Irish company incorporations, statutory registers maintenance, board minute drafting, non-resident director requirements (Section 137 revenue bonds), and registered office address facilities in Dublin.

company_knowledge.title: Business Advisory & Fractional CFO
company_knowledge.content: Strategic financial modeling, working capital optimization, cash-flow forecasting, grant claim reporting (Enterprise Ireland / IDA Ireland), and financial due diligence for M&A.

company_knowledge.title: IT, Cloud Accounting & ERP Advisory
company_knowledge.content: Independent evaluation, cloud migration, and workflow automation for systems such as Xero, Sage 50/200, NetSuite ERP, and bespoke financial reporting integrations.

company_knowledge.title: Specialist Finance & Accounting Recruitment
company_knowledge.content: Targeted sourcing and executive search for qualified accountants (ACA, ACCA, CIMA), financial controllers, tax seniors, and senior corporate finance personnel across Ireland.

company_knowledge.title: Compliance & Engagement Integrity Guidelines
company_knowledge.content: Strict compliance policy: All tax advisory strictly complies with Revenue Commissioners guidance. We do not promote aggressive tax avoidance schemes. Engagement fees are scoped transparently based on business turnover, transaction volumes, and statutory complexity following a formal discovery review.

company_knowledge.title: Non-Resident Director Requirements (Section 137)
company_knowledge.content: Q: What is required if an Irish company has no EEA resident directors? A: The company must either put in place a Section 137 Non-Resident Director Bond (valid for 2 years) or apply to Revenue for a certificate of real and continuous economic link with the State.

company_knowledge.title: Irish VAT Registration Thresholds
company_knowledge.content: Q: When must an Irish business register for VAT? A: The statutory registration threshold is currently €80,000 for the supply of goods and €40,000 for the supply of services.
